🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Mixed leadership and notable big-stock divergences (AAPL BELOW TREND vs MSFT and NVDA ABOVE TREND) support a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leading on headline movers: MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.28% | 1M: +7.28%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.47% | 1M: +2.48%). Industrials showing strength via ETN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.84% | 1M: +12.17%) and BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +3.22%). Financials constructive: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +7.77%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: VST BELOW TREND (1W: -4.87% | 1M: -8.68%), SRE BELOW TREND (1W: -5.84% | 1M: -11.52%). Healthcare soft overall with UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -4.15% | 1M: -5.08%) and ABBV BELOW TREND (1W: -5.26% | 1M: -2.82%). Consumer Staples mixed/weak: KHC TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -5.38% | 1M: +0.16%).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +27.53% | 1M: +17.92%), SHOP ABOVE TREND (1W: +20.46% | 1M: +23.67%), ETN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.84% | 1M: +12.17%), AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.61% | 1M: +11.76%), ORCL ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.47% | 1M: +2.48%). Leadership: Concentrated (3/5 Technology) — watch narrow tech tilt within the leaders.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.55% | 1M: -7.33%), F TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -7.20% | 1M: +2.15%), EOG BELOW TREND (1W: -6.40% | 1M: -0.28%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -0.31%), TTWO BELOW TREND (1W: -6.05% | 1M: -7.52%). Weakness concentrated in defensive names and select consumer/energy names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +27.53% | 1M: +17.92%) and SHOP (1W: +20.46% | 1M: +23.67%) with multiple tech names showing accelerating short-term momentum; watch for short-term mean reversion after steep runs. Note MA showing TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +10.98%) — short-term softness vs longer-term strength.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology mixed but leadership-heavy: MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%), NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.28% | 1M: +7.28%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -0.31%). Sector breadth: 12/24 positive → Internal Rotation; style: mixed given large-cap divergence.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials constructive: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.55% | 1M: +7.77%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.15% | 1M: +6.60%). Sector breadth: 12/20 positive → Internal Rotation toward cyclicals; supports selective exposure to banks and card names.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare tentative: PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +10.85%) but UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -4.15% | 1M: -5.08%) and ABBV BELOW TREND (1W: -5.26% | 1M: -2.82%). Sector breadth: 7/17 positive → Mixed; watch for earnings/news-driven dispersion.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to the strongest tech winners and cyclical pockets (MSFT, NVDA, ETN, AMZN) while reducing exposure to leading defensive laggards (CVS, utilities) and names showing TREND EXHAUSTION (KHC, MA). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given concentrated tech top performers but broad mixed breadth.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%) — follow-through on momentum; NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.28% | 1M: +7.28%) — watch resistance levels. BEARISH: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -0.31%) — watch for further distribution; CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.55% | 1M: -7.33%) — earnings/news risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology and Industrials (Tech: 12/24 positive; Industrials: 11/15 positive) on concentrated leadership and strong 1W gains. BEARISH: Utilities and Healthcare if negative news momentum persists (Utilities: 0.0/10 weak; Healthcare: 7/17 mixed).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
MSFT continuation level around prior-week highs to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; NVDA short-term resistance near recent swing highs as a trigger for further upside; AAPL near recent support zone — a break would deepen BELOW TREND signal; JPM above recent 1M highs would confirm financials' leadership continuation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
EMR (+80): Emerson headline beat noted — price showing strength via ETN/industrial peers ABOVE TREND (ETN ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.84% | 1M: +12.17%)) — sentiment appears confirming industrial strength. TMO (+80): Thermo Fisher upbeat outlook; cross-market signals show healthcare dispersion with PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +10.85%) — sentiment likely confirming selective accumulation. MRK (+80): raised outlook and approvals; monitor catalog of healthcare winners vs losers for confirmation.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-75): legal hit is bearish; META POTENTIAL REVERSAL (1W: +9.44% | 1M: -2.19%) — news is a clear divergence to watch. BA (-55): FAA inspection headlines contrast with BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +3.22%), a classic confirmation vs event risk — monitor. KHC (-55): impairment-driven weakness aligns with TREND EXHAUSTION (1W: -5.38% | 1M: +0.16%) — sentiment and price are confirming near-term stress.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with mixed style; breadth 6/11 and concentrated tech leadership imply no decisive regime shift. MSFT ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +30.40%) and NVDA ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.28% | 1M: +7.28%) are showing strength while AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -0.31%) and CVS BELOW TREND (1W: -8.55% | 1M: -7.33%) show clear weakness. Key risk: major-stock divergences and mixed news sentiment (e.g., META legal hit) — watch for confirmation before adding directional exposure.
